inputs.text: SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council has given the government one month over the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement, with an indefinite nationwide strike on the table. This doesn’t look like a simple failure to reach a deal: keeping workers waiting and universities under pressure serves someone, while the threat of a strike could conveniently make workers the public scapegoats and keep the people benefiting from the delay out of sight.
